ai_agent_certification_status
views.definition:
SELECT a.agent_key,
    a.name,
    a.status AS agent_status,
    c.certification_status,
    c.security_verified,
    c.configuration_verified,
    c.workflow_verified,
    c.output_schema_verified,
    c.human_approval_verified,
    c.audit_verified,
    c.quality_suite_verified,
    c.safety_gate_verified,
    c.e2e_verified,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.security_verified AND c.configuration_verified AND c.workflow_verified AND c.output_schema_verified AND c.human_approval_verified AND c.audit_verified AND c.quality_suite_verified AND c.safety_gate_verified AND c.e2e_verified) THEN 'eligible_for_live'::text
            ELSE 'not_ready'::text
        END AS readiness
   FROM (ai_agent_registry a
     JOIN ai_agent_certifications c ON ((c.agent_id = a.id)))
  WHERE (a.owner_role = 'client_coach'::text);

views.name: ai_cost_guardrail_status
views.definition:
SELECT g.id AS guardrail_id,
    g.service_id,
    s.name AS service_name,
    g.period_type,
    g.budget_usd,
    g.warning_pct,
    g.critical_pct,
    (COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE ((g.period_type = 'per_delivery'::text) OR ((g.period_type = 'daily'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('day'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'weekly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('week'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'monthly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now()))))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,6) AS period_ai_cost_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN ((g.budget_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (g.budget_usd > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE ((g.period_type = 'per_delivery'::text) OR ((g.period_type = 'daily'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('day'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'weekly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('week'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'monthly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now()))))), (0)::numeric) / g.budget_usd) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS budget_utilization_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((g.budget_usd IS NULL) OR (g.budget_usd <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'unconfigured'::text
            WHEN (((COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE ((g.period_type = 'per_delivery'::text) OR ((g.period_type = 'daily'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('day'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'weekly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('week'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'monthly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now()))))), (0)::numeric) / g.budget_usd) * (100)::numeric) >= g.critical_pct) THEN 'critical'::text
            WHEN (((COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE ((g.period_type = 'per_delivery'::text) OR ((g.period_type = 'daily'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('day'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'weekly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('week'::text, now()))) OR ((g.period_type = 'monthly'::text) AND (a.created_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now()))))), (0)::numeric) / g.budget_usd) * (100)::numeric) >= g.warning_pct) THEN 'warning'::text
            ELSE 'within_budget'::text
        END AS guardrail_status
   FROM ((ai_cost_budget_guardrails g
     JOIN services s ON ((s.id = g.service_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ai_service_cost_allocations a ON ((a.service_id = g.service_id)))
  GROUP BY g.id, g.service_id, s.name, g.period_type, g.budget_usd, g.warning_pct, g.critical_pct;

views.name: ai_governance_agent_performance
views.definition:
SELECT a.id AS agent_id,
    a.agent_key,
    a.name,
    a.status,
    a.autonomy_level,
    count(DISTINCT e.id) AS executions_30d,
    count(DISTINCT e.id) FILTER (WHERE (e.status = 'completed'::text)) AS completed_30d,
    count(DISTINCT e.id) FILTER (WHERE (e.status = 'failed'::text)) AS failed_30d,
    count(DISTINCT e.id) FILTER (WHERE (e.status = 'blocked'::text)) AS blocked_30d,
    round(((100.0 * (count(DISTINCT e.id) FILTER (WHERE (e.status = 'completed'::text)))::numeric) / (NULLIF(count(DISTINCT e.id), 0))::numeric), 2) AS completion_rate_pct,
    COALESCE(sum(u.total_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS tokens_30d,
    COALESCE(sum(u.estimated_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS estimated_cost_30d
   FROM ((ai_agent_registry a
     LEFT JOIN ai_agent_executions e ON (((e.agent_id = a.id) AND (e.created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)))))
     LEFT JOIN ai_usage_events u ON ((u.created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))))
  WHERE (a.active = true)
  GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_key, a.name, a.status, a.autonomy_level;

views.name: ai_governance_dashboard_summary
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_registry
          WHERE (ai_agent_registry.active = true)) AS active_agents,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE (ai_agent_executions.status = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'awaiting_quality'::text, 'awaiting_human_review'::text]))) AS active_executions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE ((ai_agent_executions.status = 'failed'::text) AND (ai_agent_executions.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)))) AS failed_executions_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_workflow_quality_evaluations
          WHERE ((ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.passed = false) AND (ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)))) AS quality_failures_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_workflow_quality_evaluations
          WHERE ((ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.passed = false) AND (ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.severity = 'critical'::text) AND (ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)))) AS critical_quality_failures_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_workflow_reviews
          WHERE (ai_workflow_reviews.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))) AS reviews_7d,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_workflow_revision_requests
          WHERE (ai_workflow_revision_requests.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'queued'::text, 'in_progress'::text]))) AS open_revisions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_improvement_signals
          WHERE (ai_improvement_signals.status = 'new'::text)) AS new_improvement_signals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_operational_alerts
          WHERE (ai_operational_alerts.status = 'open'::text)) AS open_alerts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_output_versions
          WHERE (ai_output_versions.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))) AS outputs_7d;

views.name: ai_governance_runtime_health
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_registry
          WHERE (ai_agent_registry.active = true)) AS active_agents,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE (ai_agent_executions.status = 'running'::text)) AS running_executions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE (ai_agent_executions.status = 'awaiting_quality'::text)) AS awaiting_quality,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE (ai_agent_executions.status = 'awaiting_human_review'::text)) AS awaiting_human_review,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE ((ai_agent_executions.status = 'failed'::text) AND (ai_agent_executions.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS failed_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_agent_executions
          WHERE ((ai_agent_executions.status = 'blocked'::text) AND (ai_agent_executions.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS blocked_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_workflow_quality_evaluations
          WHERE ((ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.passed = false) AND (ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS quality_failures_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_workflow_quality_evaluations
          WHERE ((ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.passed = false) AND (ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.severity = 'critical'::text) AND (ai_workflow_quality_evaluations.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS critical_quality_failures_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_operational_alerts
          WHERE (ai_operational_alerts.status = 'open'::text)) AS open_alerts,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(ai_usage_events.total_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM ai_usage_events
          WHERE (ai_usage_events.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS tokens_24h,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(ai_usage_events.estimated_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM ai_usage_events
          WHERE (ai_usage_events.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS estimated_cost_24h;

views.name: ai_revenue_payment_intelligence
views.definition:
SELECT o.id AS order_id,
    o.client_id,
    o.service_id,
    o.service_request_id,
    o.status AS order_status,
    o.amount AS verified_revenue,
    o.currency AS revenue_currency,
    o.payment_reference,
    o.paid_at,
    (COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,6) AS ai_cost_usd,
    COALESCE(sum(a.total_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS total_tokens,
    count(DISTINCT a.delivery_run_id) AS delivery_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN (o.currency = 'USD'::text) THEN (COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,6)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS ai_cost_compatible_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN (o.currency = 'USD'::text) THEN ((o.amount - COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS contribution_after_ai_cost_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN ((o.currency = 'USD'::text) AND (o.amount <> (0)::numeric)) THEN round((((o.amount - COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric)) / o.amount) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS contribution_margin_after_ai_pct
   FROM (orders o
     LEFT JOIN ai_service_cost_allocations a ON (((a.service_id = o.service_id) AND (a.delivery_run_id IN ( SELECT dr.id
           FROM ai_service_delivery_runs dr
          WHERE ((dr.client_id = o.client_id) AND ((o.service_request_id IS NULL) OR (dr.service_request_id = o.service_request_id))))))))
  WHERE (o.paid_at IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY o.id, o.client_id, o.service_id, o.service_request_id, o.status, o.amount, o.currency, o.payment_reference, o.paid_at;

views.name: ai_service_cost_margin_intelligence
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS service_id,
    s.name AS service_name,
    s.currency AS service_currency,
    COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) AS service_price,
    ec.human_delivery_hours,
    ec.human_cost_rate,
    ec.target_ai_cost_ceiling,
    ec.target_gross_margin_pct,
    (COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,6) AS ai_cost_usd,
    COALESCE(sum(a.input_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS input_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(a.output_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS output_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(a.total_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS total_tokens,
    count(DISTINCT a.delivery_run_id) AS delivery_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN ((ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate))::numeric(14,2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS human_delivery_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN (((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) - COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric)) - (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)))::numeric(14,2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS estimated_gross_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) <> (0)::numeric) AND (ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN round(((((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) - COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric)) - (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)) / COALESCE(ec.price, s.price)) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS estimated_gross_margin_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ec.target_ai_cost_ceiling IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(sum(a.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) > ec.target_ai_cost_ceiling)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS ai_cost_ceiling_exceeded
   FROM ((services s
     LEFT JOIN service_unit_economics_config ec ON (((ec.service_id = s.id) AND (ec.active = true))))
     LEFT JOIN ai_service_cost_allocations a ON ((a.service_id = s.id)))
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.currency, s.price, ec.price, ec.human_delivery_hours, ec.human_cost_rate, ec.target_ai_cost_ceiling, ec.target_gross_margin_pct;

views.name: ai_service_profitability_dashboard
views.definition:
SELECT service_id,
    service_name,
    service_currency,
    current_price,
    ai_cost_usd,
    human_delivery_cost,
    estimated_total_delivery_cost,
    estimated_margin_pct,
    target_margin_pct,
    target_margin_price,
    recommendation_type,
        CASE
            WHEN ((target_margin_pct IS NOT NULL) AND (estimated_margin_pct IS NOT NULL) AND (estimated_margin_pct < target_margin_pct)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS below_target_margin
   FROM ai_service_profitability_intelligence p;

views.name: ai_service_profitability_intelligence
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS service_id,
    s.name AS service_name,
    s.currency AS service_currency,
    COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) AS current_price,
    ec.id AS economics_config_id,
    ec.target_gross_margin_pct AS target_margin_pct,
    ec.human_delivery_hours,
    ec.human_cost_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS human_delivery_cost,
    COALESCE(c.ai_cost_usd, (0)::numeric) AS ai_cost_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN (COALESCE(c.ai_cost_usd, (0)::numeric) + (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate))
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS estimated_total_delivery_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) <> (0)::numeric) AND (ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN round(((((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) - COALESCE(c.ai_cost_usd, (0)::numeric)) - (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)) / COALESCE(ec.price, s.price)) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS estimated_margin_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((ec.target_gross_margin_pct IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL) AND (ec.target_gross_margin_pct < (100)::numeric)) THEN round(((COALESCE(c.ai_cost_usd, (0)::numeric) + (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)) / ((1)::numeric - (ec.target_gross_margin_pct / (100)::numeric))), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS target_margin_price,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) IS NULL) OR (ec.target_gross_margin_pct IS NULL) OR (ec.human_delivery_hours IS NULL) OR (ec.human_cost_rate IS NULL) OR (ec.target_gross_margin_pct >= (100)::numeric)) THEN 'insufficient_data'::text
            WHEN (((COALESCE(c.ai_cost_usd, (0)::numeric) + (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)) / ((1)::numeric - (ec.target_gross_margin_pct / (100)::numeric))) > COALESCE(ec.price, s.price)) THEN 'increase_price'::text
            WHEN (((COALESCE(c.ai_cost_usd, (0)::numeric) + (ec.human_delivery_hours * ec.human_cost_rate)) / ((1)::numeric - (ec.target_gross_margin_pct / (100)::numeric))) < (COALESCE(ec.price, s.price) * 0.9)) THEN 'cost_optimization'::text
            ELSE 'maintain_price'::text
        END AS recommendation_type
   FROM ((services s
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.id,
            x.service_id,
            x.version,
            x.pricing_model,
            x.currency,
            x.price,
            x.human_delivery_hours,
            x.human_cost_rate,
            x.target_ai_cost_ceiling,
            x.target_gross_margin_pct,
            x.active,
            x.notes,
            x.created_by,
            x.created_at,
            x.updated_at
           FROM service_unit_economics_config x
          WHERE ((x.service_id = s.id) AND (x.active = true))
          ORDER BY x.version DESC
         LIMIT 1) ec ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (sum(a.ai_cost_usd))::numeric(14,6) AS ai_cost_usd
           FROM ai_service_cost_allocations a
          WHERE (a.service_id = s.id)) c ON (true));

views.name: ai_test_control_center_v57
views.definition:
SELECT g.id AS group_id,
    g.name AS group_name,
    g.status AS group_status,
    count(gc.test_case_id) FILTER (WHERE gc.active) AS test_cases,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_test_control_runs r
          WHERE ((r.group_id = g.id) AND (r.status = 'passed'::text))), (0)::bigint) AS passed_runs,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_test_control_runs r
          WHERE ((r.group_id = g.id) AND (r.status = 'failed'::text))), (0)::bigint) AS failed_runs,
    g.updated_at
   FROM (ai_test_control_groups g
     LEFT JOIN ai_test_control_group_cases gc ON ((gc.group_id = g.id)))
  GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.status, g.updated_at;

views.name: careerdev_financial_intelligence_dashboard
views.definition:
SELECT o.currency,
    count(*) AS paid_orders,
    (COALESCE(sum(o.amount), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,2) AS gross_verified_revenue,
    round((COALESCE(sum(o.amount), (0)::numeric) * ( SELECT (platform_revenue_split_config.platform_share_pct / (100)::numeric)
           FROM platform_revenue_split_config
          WHERE (platform_revenue_split_config.active = true)
          ORDER BY platform_revenue_split_config.effective_from DESC
         LIMIT 1)), 2) AS careerdev_platform_share,
    round((COALESCE(sum(o.amount), (0)::numeric) * ( SELECT (platform_revenue_split_config.coach_share_pct / (100)::numeric)
           FROM platform_revenue_split_config
          WHERE (platform_revenue_split_config.active = true)
          ORDER BY platform_revenue_split_config.effective_from DESC
         LIMIT 1)), 2) AS coach_gross_share,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (o.currency = 'USD'::text) THEN r.ai_cost_usd
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,6) AS ai_cost_usd,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (o.currency = 'USD'::text) THEN r.ai_cost_usd
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,6) AS ai_cost_usd_comparable,
        CASE
            WHEN (o.currency = 'USD'::text) THEN round((COALESCE(sum(o.amount), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(r.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric)), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS contribution_after_ai_cost_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN ((o.currency = 'USD'::text) AND (sum(o.amount) <> (0)::numeric)) THEN round((((COALESCE(sum(o.amount), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(r.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric)) / sum(o.amount)) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS contribution_margin_after_ai_pct
   FROM (orders o
     LEFT JOIN ai_revenue_payment_intelligence r ON ((r.order_id = o.id)))
  WHERE (o.paid_at IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY o.currency;

views.name: careerdev_marketplace_economics_summary
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coaches
          WHERE (coaches.application_status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::coach_status, 'active'::coach_status]))) AS approved_coaches,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM services
          WHERE (services.active = true)) AS active_services,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM orders
          WHERE (orders.paid_at IS NOT NULL)) AS paid_orders,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(orders.amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM orders
          WHERE (orders.paid_at IS NOT NULL)) AS gross_verified_revenue,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum((orders.amount * ( SELECT (platform_revenue_split_config.platform_share_pct / (100)::numeric)
                   FROM platform_revenue_split_config
                  WHERE (platform_revenue_split_config.active = true)
                  ORDER BY platform_revenue_split_config.effective_from DESC
                 LIMIT 1))), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM orders
          WHERE (orders.paid_at IS NOT NULL)) AS platform_share,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum((orders.amount * ( SELECT (platform_revenue_split_config.coach_share_pct / (100)::numeric)
                   FROM platform_revenue_split_config
                  WHERE (platform_revenue_split_config.active = true)
                  ORDER BY platform_revenue_split_config.effective_from DESC
                 LIMIT 1))), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM orders
          WHERE (orders.paid_at IS NOT NULL)) AS coach_share,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ai_operational_alerts
          WHERE (ai_operational_alerts.status = 'open'::text)) AS open_ai_alerts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM client_service_outcomes

           FROM marketplace_booking_requests b
          WHERE (b.client_id = c.id)), (0)::bigint) AS total_bookings,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_booking_requests b
          WHERE ((b.client_id = c.id) AND (b.booking_status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'confirmed'::text])))), (0)::bigint) AS active_bookings,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_booking_requests b
          WHERE ((b.client_id = c.id) AND (b.booking_status = 'completed'::text))), (0)::bigint) AS completed_bookings,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_transactions t
          WHERE ((t.client_id = c.id) AND (t.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['funded'::text, 'authorized'::text, 'paid'::text, 'succeeded'::text])))), (0)::bigint) AS funded_transactions,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(t.gross_amount) AS sum
           FROM marketplace_transactions t
          WHERE ((t.client_id = c.id) AND (t.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['funded'::text, 'authorized'::text, 'paid'::text, 'succeeded'::text])))), (0)::numeric) AS total_spend,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_reviews r
          WHERE (r.client_id = c.id)), (0)::bigint) AS reviews_submitted,
    ( SELECT p.id
           FROM client_marketplace_progress p

   FROM clients c;

    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM coach_availability a

    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_booking_requests b
          WHERE ((b.coach_id = cmp.coach_id) AND (b.booking_status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'confirmed'::text])))) AS active_bookings,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_booking_requests b
          WHERE ((b.coach_id = cmp.coach_id) AND (b.booking_status = 'completed'::text))) AS completed_bookings,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(r.rating), 2), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM marketplace_reviews r
          WHERE ((r.coach_id = cmp.coach_id) AND (r.status = 'published'::text))) AS average_rating,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_reviews r
          WHERE ((r.coach_id = cmp.coach_id) AND (r.status = 'published'::text))) AS review_count,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(e.coach_amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM coach_earnings_ledger e
          WHERE ((e.coach_id = cmp.coach_id) AND (e.ledger_status = ANY (ARRAY['earned'::text, 'payable'::text, 'paid'::text])))) AS lifetime_coach_earnings,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(e.coach_amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM coach_earnings_ledger e
          WHERE ((e.coach_id = cmp.coach_id) AND (e.ledger_status = 'payable'::text))) AS payable_earnings

    cmp.country,
    cmp.years_coaching,
    cmp.verification_status,
    cmp.marketplace_status,
    cmp.profile_completion_pct,
    (COALESCE(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN (mr.status = 'published'::text) THEN mr.rating
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(4,2) AS average_rating,
    (count(mr.id) FILTER (WHERE (mr.status = 'published'::text)))::integer AS review_count,
    min(cso.price) FILTER (WHERE ((cso.active = true) AND (cso.price IS NOT NULL) AND (cso.price > (0)::numeric))) AS minimum_price,
    array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT cso.currency) FILTER (WHERE ((cso.active = true) AND (cso.price IS NOT NULL) AND (cso.price > (0)::numeric))), NULL::text) AS currencies,
    array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT cso.delivery_mode) FILTER (WHERE (cso.active = true)), NULL::text) AS delivery_modes
   FROM ((((coaches c
     JOIN coach_marketplace_profiles cmp ON ((cmp.coach_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN marketplace_reviews mr ON ((mr.coach_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN coach_service_offerings cso ON ((cso.coach_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN coach_marketplace_onboarding o ON ((o.coach_id = c.id)))
  WHERE ((c.application_status = 'active'::coach_status) AND (cmp.marketplace_status = 'active'::text) AND (cmp.verification_status = ANY (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'approved'::text])) AND (COALESCE(o.eligible_for_activation, false) = true))
  GROUP BY c.id, cmp.id, cmp.display_name, cmp.headline, cmp.bio, cmp.specializations, cmp.coaching_formats, cmp.languages, cmp.timezone, cmp.country, cmp.years_coaching, cmp.verification_status, cmp.marketplace_status, cmp.profile_completion_pct;

views.name: marketplace_coach_earnings_summary
views.definition:
SELECT coach_id,
    currency,
    COALESCE(sum(coach_amount) FILTER (WHERE (ledger_status = ANY (ARRAY['earned'::text, 'payable'::text]))), (0)::numeric) AS earned_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(coach_amount) FILTER (WHERE (ledger_status = 'payable'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS payable_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(coach_amount) FILTER (WHERE (ledger_status = 'paid'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS paid_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(coach_amount) FILTER (WHERE (ledger_status = ANY (ARRAY['held'::text, 'pending'::text]))), (0)::numeric) AS held_amount,
    count(*) AS ledger_entries
   FROM coach_earnings_ledger e
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (coaches c
             JOIN profiles p ON ((p.id = c.profile_id)))
          WHERE ((c.id = e.coach_id) AND (p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
  GROUP BY coach_id, currency;

views.name: marketplace_coach_matching_candidates
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS coach_id,
    cmp.id AS marketplace_profile_id,
    cmp.display_name,
    cmp.headline,
    cmp.bio,
    cmp.specializations,
    cmp.coaching_formats,
    cmp.languages,
    cmp.timezone,
    cmp.country,
    cmp.years_coaching,
    cmp.verification_status,
    cmp.marketplace_status,
    COALESCE(avg(mr.rating), (0)::numeric) AS average_rating,
    (count(mr.id))::integer AS review_count
   FROM ((coaches c
     JOIN coach_marketplace_profiles cmp ON ((cmp.coach_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN marketplace_reviews mr ON (((mr.coach_id = c.id) AND (mr.status = 'published'::text))))
  WHERE ((c.application_status = 'active'::coach_status) AND (cmp.verification_status = 'verified'::text) AND (cmp.marketplace_status = 'active'::text))
  GROUP BY c.id, cmp.id;

views.name: marketplace_coach_payout_summary
views.definition:
SELECT coach_id,
    currency,
    COALESCE(sum(payout_amount) FILTER (WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'eligible'::text, 'processing'::text, 'on_hold'::text]))), (0)::numeric) AS outstanding_payout_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(payout_amount) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'paid'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS paid_payout_amount,
    count(*) AS payout_count
   FROM marketplace_payouts p
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (coaches c
             JOIN profiles pr ON ((pr.id = c.profile_id)))
          WHERE ((c.id = p.coach_id) AND (pr.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
  GROUP BY coach_id, currency;

views.name: marketplace_communication_risk_summary
views.definition:
SELECT moderation_status,
    policy_action,
    count(*) AS message_count,
    COALESCE(avg(risk_score), (0)::numeric) AS avg_risk_score
   FROM marketplace_communications
  GROUP BY moderation_status, policy_action;

views.name: marketplace_dispute_summary
views.definition:
SELECT d.id,
    d.transaction_id,
    d.opened_by,
    d.reason,
    d.status,
    d.requested_resolution,
    d.amount_at_risk,
    d.currency,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at,
    t.client_id,
    t.coach_id,
    t.payment_status,
    t.fulfillment_status,
    t.release_eligibility,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(r.amount) AS sum
           FROM marketplace_refunds r
          WHERE ((r.transaction_id = d.transaction_id) AND (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'processing'::text, 'completed'::text, 'partially_completed'::text])))), (0)::numeric) AS refunded_amount
   FROM (marketplace_disputes d
     JOIN marketplace_transactions t ON ((t.id = d.transaction_id)));

views.name: marketplace_financial_compliance_dashboard
views.definition:
SELECT status,
    severity,
    exception_type,
    count(*) AS exception_count,
    min(created_at) AS first_detected,
    max(created_at) AS last_detected
   FROM marketplace_financial_audit_exceptions
  GROUP BY status, severity, exception_type;

views.name: marketplace_financial_ledger_integrity
views.definition:
SELECT t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.currency,
    t.gross_amount,
    t.platform_share_pct,
    t.coach_share_pct,
    t.platform_fee,
    t.coach_earnings,
    COALESCE(r.refund_total, (0)::numeric) AS refund_total,
    COALESCE(p.payout_total, (0)::numeric) AS payout_total,
    ((abs(((t.platform_share_pct + t.coach_share_pct) - (100)::numeric)) < 0.000001) AND (abs(((t.platform_fee + t.coach_earnings) - t.gross_amount)) < 0.000001)) AS split_integrity,
    (COALESCE(r.refund_total, (0)::numeric) <= t.gross_amount) AS refund_integrity,
    (COALESCE(p.payout_total, (0)::numeric) <= t.coach_earnings) AS payout_integrity,
    (COALESCE(l.entry_count, (0)::bigint) > 0) AS ledger_entries_present
   FROM (((marketplace_transactions t
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT marketplace_refunds.transaction_id,
            sum(marketplace_refunds.amount) AS refund_total
           FROM marketplace_refunds
          WHERE (marketplace_refunds.status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'processing'::text, 'completed'::text, 'partially_completed'::text]))
          GROUP BY marketplace_refunds.transaction_id) r ON ((r.transaction_id = t.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT marketplace_payouts.transaction_id,
            sum(marketplace_payouts.payout_amount) AS payout_total
           FROM marketplace_payouts
          WHERE (marketplace_payouts.status = ANY (ARRAY['processing'::text, 'paid'::text, 'eligible'::text]))
          GROUP BY marketplace_payouts.transaction_id) p ON ((p.transaction_id = t.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT marketplace_ledger_entries.transaction_id,
            count(*) AS entry_count
           FROM marketplace_ledger_entries
          GROUP BY marketplace_ledger_entries.transaction_id) l ON ((l.transaction_id = t.id)));

views.name: marketplace_financial_operations_alert_dashboard
views.definition:
SELECT alert_type,
    severity,
    status,
    count(*) AS alert_count,
    max(last_detected_at) AS last_detected_at
   FROM marketplace_financial_operations_alerts
  GROUP BY alert_type, severity, status;

views.name: marketplace_financial_operations_by_currency
views.definition:
SELECT currency,
    count(*) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(sum(gross_amount), (0)::numeric) AS gross_value,
    COALESCE(sum(platform_fee), (0)::numeric) AS platform_revenue,
    COALESCE(sum(coach_earnings), (0)::numeric) AS coach_entitlements
   FROM marketplace_transactions
  GROUP BY currency
  ORDER BY currency;

views.name: marketplace_financial_operations_command_center
views.definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_transactions) AS total_transactions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_transactions
          WHERE (marketplace_transactions.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['funded'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'paid'::text, 'held'::text]))) AS funded_transactions,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(marketplace_transactions.gross_amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM marketplace_transactions) AS gross_transaction_value,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(marketplace_transactions.platform_fee), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM marketplace_transactions) AS platform_revenue,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(marketplace_transactions.coach_earnings), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM marketplace_transactions) AS coach_entitlements,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_payment_reconciliation
          WHERE (marketplace_payment_reconciliation.reconciliation_status = ANY (ARRAY['mismatch'::text, 'pending'::text]))) AS reconciliation_exceptions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_financial_audit_exceptions
          WHERE (marketplace_financial_audit_exceptions.status = 'open'::text)) AS open_financial_exceptions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_disputes
          WHERE (marketplace_disputes.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'under_review'::text, 'awaiting_response'::text, 'escalated'::text]))) AS open_disputes,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(marketplace_refunds.amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM marketplace_refunds
          WHERE (marketplace_refunds.status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'under_review'::text, 'approved'::text, 'processing'::text]))) AS pending_refund_exposure,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(marketplace_payouts.payout_amount), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM marketplace_payouts
          WHERE (marketplace_payouts.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'eligible'::text, 'processing'::text, 'on_hold'::text]))) AS pending_payout_value,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_payouts
          WHERE (marketplace_payouts.release_check_status = 'blocked'::text)) AS blocked_payouts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM marketplace_payment_webhook_events
          WHERE (marketplace_payment_webhook_events.processing_status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'failed'::text]))) AS webhook_attention_required;

views.name: marketplace_financial_operations_exceptions
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    transaction_id,
    payout_id,
    refund_id,
    exception_type,
    severity,
    status,
    description,
    detected_by,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM marketplace_financial_audit_exceptions
  WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'under_review'::text]))
  ORDER BY
        CASE severity
            WHEN 'critical'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'high'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'medium'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END, created_at DESC;

views.name: marketplace_payment_status_summary
views.definition:
SELECT t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.client_id,
    t.coach_id,
    t.service_id,
    t.currency,
    t.gross_amount,
    t.payment_status,
    t.fulfillment_status,
    t.release_eligibility,
    pi.id AS payment_intent_id,
    pi.provider_key,
    pi.status AS payment_intent_status,
    pi.provider_intent_reference,
    pi.created_at AS payment_intent_created_at
   FROM (marketplace_transactions t
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.id,
            p.transaction_id,

views.name: marketplace_transaction_summary

views.name: service_unit_economics
views.definition:
WITH ai_costs AS (
         SELECT sr.service_id,
            sr.id AS service_request_id,
            COALESCE(sum(ue.estimated_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS ai_cost_usd,
            COALESCE(sum(ue.total_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS total_tokens
           FROM (service_requests sr
             LEFT JOIN ai_usage_events ue ON (((ue.client_id = sr.client_id) AND ((ue.request_id = sr.id) OR (ue.run_id IN ( SELECT adr.id
                   FROM ai_service_delivery_runs adr
                  WHERE (adr.service_request_id = sr.id)))))))
          GROUP BY sr.service_id, sr.id
        ), human_costs AS (
         SELECT sr.service_id,
            sr.id AS service_request_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((cfg_1.human_delivery_hours IS NOT NULL) AND (cfg_1.human_cost_rate IS NOT NULL)) THEN (cfg_1.human_delivery_hours * cfg_1.human_cost_rate)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS human_delivery_cost
           FROM (service_requests sr
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.id,
                    c.service_id,
                    c.version,
                    c.pricing_model,
                    c.currency,
                    c.price,
                    c.human_delivery_hours,
                    c.human_cost_rate,
                    c.target_ai_cost_ceiling,
                    c.target_gross_margin_pct,
                    c.active,
                    c.notes,
                    c.created_by,
                    c.created_at,
                    c.updated_at
                   FROM service_unit_economics_config c
                  WHERE ((c.service_id = sr.service_id) AND (c.active = true))
                  ORDER BY c.version DESC
                 LIMIT 1) cfg_1 ON (true))
        )
 SELECT s.id AS service_id,
    s.name AS service_name,
    s.currency AS service_currency,
    s.price AS service_catalog_price,
    cfg.version AS economics_version,
    cfg.pricing_model,
    cfg.human_delivery_hours,
    cfg.human_cost_rate,
    cfg.target_ai_cost_ceiling,
    cfg.target_gross_margin_pct,
    COALESCE(sum(ac.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS ai_cost_usd,
    (COALESCE(sum(ac.total_tokens), (0)::numeric))::bigint AS total_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(hc.human_delivery_cost), (0)::numeric) AS human_delivery_cost,
    count(DISTINCT ac.service_request_id) AS service_requests_with_usage,
        CASE
            WHEN (count(DISTINCT ac.service_request_id) > 0) THEN (COALESCE(sum(ac.ai_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) / (count(DISTINCT ac.service_request_id))::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS avg_ai_cost_per_request_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN (count(DISTINCT ac.service_request_id) > 0) THEN (COALESCE(sum(hc.human_delivery_cost), (0)::numeric) / (count(DISTINCT ac.service_request_id))::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS avg_human_cost_per_request,
    NULL::numeric AS revenue_recorded,
    NULL::numeric AS gross_profit,
    NULL::numeric AS gross_margin_pct,
    now() AS calculated_at
   FROM (((services s
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.id,
            c.service_id,
            c.version,
            c.pricing_model,
            c.currency,
            c.price,
            c.human_delivery_hours,
            c.human_cost_rate,
            c.target_ai_cost_ceiling,
            c.target_gross_margin_pct,
            c.active,
            c.notes,
            c.created_by,
            c.created_at,
            c.updated_at
           FROM service_unit_economics_config c
          WHERE ((c.service_id = s.id) AND (c.active = true))
          ORDER BY c.version DESC
         LIMIT 1) cfg ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN ai_costs ac ON ((ac.service_id = s.id)))
     LEFT JOIN human_costs hc ON ((hc.service_request_id = ac.service_request_id)))
  WHERE (s.active = true)
  GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.currency, s.price, cfg.version, cfg.pricing_model, cfg.human_delivery_hours, cfg.human_cost_rate, cfg.target_ai_cost_ceiling, cfg.target_gross_margin_pct;

views.name: decrypted_secrets
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    name,
    description,
    secret,
    convert_from(vault._crypto_aead_det_decrypt(message => decode(secret, 'base64'::text), additional => convert_to((id)::text, 'utf8'::name), key_id => (0)::bigint, context => '\x7067736f6469756d'::bytea, nonce => nonce), 'utf8'::name) AS decrypted_secret,
    key_id,
    nonce,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM vault.secrets s;
